title: Camareira
description:
Descrição da vaga:

Ofereça os seus serviços de camareira para hotéis através da b2bhotel. Você tem flexibilidade para escolher os seus horários de trabalho e quais serviços deseja realizar. O controle da sua agenda é feito de forma online e os pagamentos são feitos semanalmente, de acordo com os serviços realizados naquela semana.


O que preciso para me aplicar?

Possuir ao menos 1 referência de hotel onde tenha trabalhado como camareira,

Possuir MEI,

Possuir ao menos 3 meses de experiência comprovada na área.

title: Manicure
description:
Realize atendimentos de Manicure, Pedicure e Spa dos pés. É preciso seguir os padrões de qualidade, higiene e biossegurança definidos pela Bluma. Também é esperado que você mantenha postura profissional, pontualidade e bom relacionamento com a equipe e com o público atendido. Todos os materiais necessários para os atendimentos, assim como o uniforme completo, serão disponibilizados pela Bluma. Os atendimento serão realizados em estabelecimentos da Bluma localizados em aeroportos.
Caso o(a) candidato(a) ainda não tenha MEI, a Bluma oferece apoio na abertura. Candidatos(as) com MEI pendente ou irregular serão desclassificadas.

title: Cabelereiro(a) ou escovista
description:
Realize atendimentos de lavagem de cabelos, escova lisa, escova modelada e babyliss pela empresa Bluma. É preciso seguir os padrões de qualidade, higiene e biossegurança definidos pela Bluma. Também é esperado que mantenha postura profissional, pontualidade e bom relacionamento com a equipe e com o público atendido. Todos os materiais necessários para os atendimentos, assim como o uniforme completo, serão disponibilizados pela Bluma.
Caso a candidata ainda não tenha MEI, a empresa oferece apoio na abertura. Candidatos(as) com MEI pendente ou irregular serão desclassificados(as).

title: Barbeiro
description: Realize atendimentos de lavagem de cabelos, escova lisa, escova modelada e babyliss pela empresa Bluma. É preciso seguir os padrões de qualidade, higiene e biossegurança definidos pela Bluma. Também é esperado que mantenha postura profissional, pontualidade e bom relacionamento com a equipe e com o público atendido. Todos os materiais necessários para os atendimentos, assim como o uniforme completo, serão disponibilizados pela Bluma. Caso o(a) candidato(a) ainda não tenha MEI, a empresa oferece apoio na abertura. Candidatos(as) com MEI pendente ou irregular serão desclassificados(as). É importante também não estar vinculada a benefícios sociais, como Bolsa Família, BPC ou similares, já que a formalização como MEI implica na perda desses benefícios.

title: Camareira
description:
Descrição da vaga:

Ofereça os seus serviços de camareira para hotéis através da b2bhotel. Você tem flexibilidade para escolher os seus horários de trabalho e quais serviços deseja realizar. O controle da sua agenda é feito de forma online e os pagamentos são feitos semanalmente, de acordo com os serviços realizados naquela semana.


O que preciso para me aplicar?

Possuir ao menos 1 referência de hotel onde tenha trabalhado como camareira,

Possuir MEI,

Possuir ao menos 3 meses de experiência comprovada na área.

title: Manicure
description:
Realize atendimentos de Manicure, Pedicure e Spa dos pés. É preciso seguir os padrões de qualidade, higiene e biossegurança definidos pela Bluma. Também é esperado que você mantenha postura profissional, pontualidade e bom relacionamento com a equipe e com o público atendido. Todos os materiais necessários para os atendimentos, assim como o uniforme completo, serão disponibilizados pela Bluma. Os atendimento serão realizados em estabelecimentos da Bluma localizados em aeroportos.
Caso o(a) candidato(a) ainda não tenha MEI, a Bluma oferece apoio na abertura. Candidatos(as) com MEI pendente ou irregular serão desclassificadas.

title: Cabelereiro(a) ou escovista
description:
Realize atendimentos de lavagem de cabelos, escova lisa, escova modelada e babyliss pela empresa Bluma. É preciso seguir os padrões de qualidade, higiene e biossegurança definidos pela Bluma. Também é esperado que mantenha postura profissional, pontualidade e bom relacionamento com a equipe e com o público atendido. Todos os materiais necessários para os atendimentos, assim como o uniforme completo, serão disponibilizados pela Bluma.
Caso a candidata ainda não tenha MEI, a empresa oferece apoio na abertura. Candidatos(as) com MEI pendente ou irregular serão desclassificados(as).

title: Engenheiro de Dados Senior
description:
Na Jaya Tech , acreditamos na Engenharia de Software Consciente , uma abordagem inovadora, e por isso oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho inspirador, focado em promover o autoconhecimento, tomar decisões embasadas em dados, cultivar relacionamentos saudáveis e entender o impacto do nosso trabalho. Aqui, você encontrará oportunidades para crescimento profissional e pessoal, contribuindo para projetos que têm um impacto significativo na indústria e na sociedade.


Sobre o Projeto

Você fará parte de um time em uma empresa inovadora, especializada em desenvolver soluções com Inteligencia Artificial (B2C) contribuindo para a transformação digital desse setor.


Atuação 100% remota | Forma de contratação: Contractor | Reuneração: Dólar | Full-time | Range: 5.2K a 6.2K


Requisitos Necessários


O que estamos procurando:


Ao avaliar candidatos para todos os cargos, buscamos pessoas com forte senso de propriedade, excelentes habilidades de comunicação e colaboração, e dedicação à melhoria contínua.


● Experiência em engenharia de dados

● Domínio de Python e DBT Cloud, incluindo macros, testes, exposures e documentação para ETL/ELT

● Experiência com event streams e stream processing

● Experiência com controle de versão e CI/CD usando GitLab

● Experiência com orquestração de jobs (Airflow, DBT Jobs, Dagster)

● Familiaridade com Snowflake (clustering, otimização de queries, gestão de custos)

● Familiaridade com boas práticas de modelagem de dados (Kimball, Star, Snowflake) e sua aplicação em data warehouses

● Conforto com a linha de comando Unix/Linux



Experiências que vão nos impressionar muito:


● Familiaridade com eCommerce e os desafios de dados anônimos de clientes e suas interações

● Familiaridade com seguros de P&C (Property & Casualty )

● Formação em áreas como: Ciência, Tecnologia, Engenharia e Matemática

title: Video Editor
description:
We are…

A leading digital media and content production group with a large global presence. At EMP, we believe in the power of content to unite and inspire people. With our innovative approach and content-first mentality, we're redefining how content is consumed and shared. We help create content at the highest level including some of the biggest professional athlete led podcasts in the world.


Like all winning teams, we value respect, creativity, and fun. We operate in a dynamic environment where collaboration drives ideation and where you will help shape the ever-growing media landscape as we know it. Here at EMP, we provide an opportunity for your voice to be heard and create a space where you can have fun in the process. We’re not just about work, rather we look to build a community that celebrates victories, learns from hardships, and grows as one. EMP is a place where your talent can shine while you make a real impact along the way.


You Are...

An experienced and driven video editor professional with experience producing quality video edits, ideally within the media, entertainment, or sports industry. You are passionate about growth, entrepreneurial in spirit, and able to work in collaboration with a team

You Will...

  • Edit audio and video for podcast, YouTube videos, advertisments, branded content, Social content and more to create high-quality, color corrected, synchronized video content.
  • Ensure audio clarity, correct sync issues, and enhance sound quality with noise reduction, EQ, and other techniques.
  • Add intro/outro music, sound effects, and transitions for a professional and polished final product.
  • Select impactful or interesting moments from episodes to create shorter video clips for social media platforms (e.g., Instagram, YouTube, TikTok).
  • Tailor clips for specific platform requirements (aspect ratios, length, captioning) and audience engagement.
  • Add dynamic motion graphics, lower thirds, captions, and animations to enhance viewer experience.
  • Create and integrate title cards, branding elements, and background visuals in alignment with the podcast’s visual identity
  • Work closely with hosts, producers, and social media managers to align on styles, themes, key messages, and desired tone
  • and more...


Job Requirements

You Have...

  • The ability to speak advanced to fluent English
  • Minimum 2-3 years of experience in video editing, preferably with podcast or interview-style content.
  • Skills Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar video editing software; familiarity with audio software (e.g., Audacity, Adobe Audition) is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of sound design, color correction, and high level motion graphics/animations.
  • Excellent attention to detail and quality control in all aspects of editing.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with multiple teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.
  • Demonstrated experience through a portfolio of video editing work.

  • Select impactful or interesting moments from episodes to create shorter video clips for social media platforms (e.g., Instagram, YouTube, TikTok).
  • Tailor clips for specific platform requirements (aspect ratios, length, captioning) and audience engagement.
  • Add dynamic motion graphics, lower thirds, captions, and animations to enhance viewer experience.
  • Create and integrate title cards, branding elements, and background visuals in alignment with the podcast’s visual identity
  • Work closely with hosts, producers, and social media managers to align on styles, themes, key messages, and desired tone
  • and more...


Job Requirements

You Have...

  • The ability to speak advanced to fluent English
  • Minimum 2-3 years of experience in video editing, preferably with podcast or interview-style content.
  • Skills Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar video editing software; familiarity with audio software (e.g., Audacity, Adobe Audition) is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of sound design, color correction, and high level motion graphics/animations.
  • Excellent attention to detail and quality control in all aspects of editing.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with multiple teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.
  • Demonstrated experience through a portfolio of video editing work.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Full Stack Engineer

Location: Remote (Brazil)

Employment Type: PJ


We’re looking for Full Stack Engineer to join our Seller team — a group of passionate, collaborative developers building seamless on-platform experiences that help us acquire and activate high-value customers. You’ll work closely with Product, Marketing, and Engineering teams to deliver elegant, scalable solutions that drive engagement and business growth.


What You’ll Do

  • Produce high-quality, performant, and testable code that drives company-wide initiatives.
  • Lead the product development process — from ideation and prototyping to implementation and release.
  • Architect and build scalable systems supporting millions of users.
  • Contribute to design and architectural decisions shaping the future of our software systems.
  • Rapidly prototype and run A/B tests to validate and optimize user experiences.
  • Mentor teammates, conduct code reviews, and pair-program to support shared learning.
  • Collaborate closely with Product and Engineering Management to align technical solutions with business goals.


Tech Stacks

Languages

  • Elixir
  • Erlang
  • Ruby
  • JavaScript
  • TypeScript

Frameworks & Libraries

  • React
  • Next.js
  • GraphQL

Technologies & Architecture

  • Kafka
  • AWS / Lambda
  • Microservices
  • RESTful APIs
  • Event-based architecture

Databases

  • PostgreSQL
  • DynamoDB

Tools & Practices

  • Git / Version control
  • IDEs
  • Continuous integration & deployment tools
  • Testing frameworks and best practices
  • CMS (Prismic)
  • A/B Testing


What You Bring

Minimum Requirements

  • 7+ years of web application development experience with a proven track record of shipping successful products.
  • Strong background in writing reliable, maintainable code and building reusable component libraries.
  • Proficiency in at least one of the core languages or frameworks listed above.
  • Passion for testing, code quality, and continuous improvement.
  • Familiarity with RESTful APIs, Git, TypeScript, and remote deployment tools.
  • Experience with event-based architectures, GraphQL, and database fundamentals.
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Curiosity about retail/e-commerce and enthusiasm for sustainability and circular economies.

Preferred Requirements

  • Experience with React, HTML/CSS, and JavaScript.
  • Background in GraphQL and microservices architecture.
  • Experience developing eCommerce platforms or working with CMS tools (especially Prismic).
  • Familiarity with mobile development (iOS and/or Android) is a plus.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Teachable is a no-code platform for creators who want to build a more impactful business through courses, coaching, downloadable content, and community. With Teachable, creators can engage their online audiences and get paid—on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creators use Teachable to share their knowledge and, to date, have reached more than 46 million students around the world.


Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!


What is the role?

We are looking for a senior engineer with backend experience, who will join our team mainly focused on backend development, always focusing on delivering applications for high traffic access, well-monitored and fully tested. You will be responsible for the entire development lifecycle. In our team, everyone has the opportunity to share ideas, bring new solutions, and discuss them with other well-experienced engineers.


In this role you'll:

  • Write secure, efficient, and high-quality code that adheres to best practices, such as encryption of sensitive data and input validation.
  • Develop scalable and reusable code that promotes efficient development, such as creating reusable libraries and components.
  • Identify areas for improvement in the codebase and take ownership of small-to-medium-sized systems, such as fixing bugs and optimizing performance.
  • Quickly understand documentation and utilize testing techniques, such as unit testing, integration testing, and stress testing, to ensure high-quality code.
  • Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders, such as providing regular status updates and actively seeking feedback.
  • Adapt to roadblocks and proactively resolve issues, such as debugging and troubleshooting.
  • Align work with customer value by using feedback to prioritize features.
  • Balance priorities and seek guidance when needed to make informed decisions.


What You’ll Bring:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience building production web applications in an agile, startup environment.
  • Experience migrating domains from monolithic to microservices.
  • Experience working with systems at scale utilizing microservices, AWS services
  • Interest in learning or exposure to event-based architecture
  • Team player mentality: high collaborative, documentation-focused and recognizing how to balance asynchronous communications and virtual meetings
  • A passion for solving complex technical problems in both new and legacy codebases.
  • A mindset of leaving the codebase better than how you found it.
  • Experience collaborating with multiple team members with varying experience levels to design and implement technical projects.
  • Ability to work and problem-solve independently.
  • A humble, collaborative, customer-focused, and highly curious approach to problem-solving.


Nice to have:

  • Golang experience


This is a CLT contract with full benefits, paid in $BRL.


Teachable encourages individuals from a broad diversity of backgrounds to apply for positions. We are an equal opportunity employer, meaning we're committed to a fair and consistent interview process. Please tell us in your application if you require an accommodation to apply for a job or to perform your job.

title: Senior Cloud Engineer
description:
English-speaking Senior Cloud Engineer (Azure or AWS)


$4,000 – $6,000 USD/month

Fully Remote

Full-time, long-term contract

Excellent English skills required for this position


About the Company


Join a US-based Cloud Expert MSP that delivers end-to-end cloud solutions to enterprise clients across the US.


Their teams design, manage, and optimize complex Azure and AWS environments for global organizations — helping businesses modernize infrastructure, reduce costs, and adopt automation-first cloud operations.


You’ll be part of a senior, high-performing Cloud Center of Excellence : a small, elite group of engineers who are the “go-to” specialists when others can’t solve it.

This is a long-term, stable remote opportunity to grow your career in a world-class engineering environment — without the red tape or endless ticket queues.


The Role


As a Senior Cloud Engineer , you’ll act as both an engineer and consultant — supporting, optimizing, and automating large-scale public cloud environments across Azure and AWS .

This is not a traditional support role — you’ll have direct customer interaction, ownership of infrastructure automation, and the freedom to solve complex challenges creatively.

You’ll work on:


  • Supporting and optimizing enterprise-scale Azure and AWS environments
  • Building automation frameworks using Terraform, Ansible, and GitOps principles
  • Proactive governance and cost optimization reviews using Cloud Insights (Flexera CloudCheckr)
  • Designing and deploying Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM/Bicep)
  • Advising customers on modernization, containers (AKS/EKS), and cloud-native adoption
  • Collaborating with Product and Professional Services teams on new initiatives and deployments


What You’ll Bring


  • 5+ years’ experience as a Cloud Engineer / DevOps / Infrastructure Engineer
  • Strong hands-on expertise in Azure OR AWS (ideally both)
  • Proven experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
  • Experience with Kubernetes (AKS, EKS) and cloud-native services (App Services, Lambda, etc.)
  • Understanding of networking, hybrid connectivity, and governance best practices
  • Exposure to automation tools such as Ansible, GitOps, CI/CD pipelines

title: Wordpress Plugin & Full Stack Developer
description:
Please only apply if you are familiar with Wordpress Plugin Development, with strong PHP skills in additional to being a full stack (front and back) developer. Ideally you should also be comfortable with mobile apps and figuring out and doing different things in tech and thrive in a fast-paced fluid environment.


Do you love technology puzzles and figuring out how to make a variety of things to work? Are you great at catching mistakes through user testing for quality assurance? Are you a dedicated, resourceful team player with strong problem solving skills? Do you have experience working with numerous different technology platforms in digital form, ranging from CRMs (like Constant Contact, Aweber, Beehiiv), Hosting (AWS, WHM), DNS (Cloudflare), Automtions (like zapier, make.com), project management (like jira.com)?


Detail oriented test and php / elementor test REQUIRED before video interview.


About Us

Life Water Media specializes in digital branding and awareness campaigns for publicly traded companies in the United States stock market and other large scale projects. We started in 2019. We internally own 10 newsletter brands, a mobile app, and other digital assets.


Responsibilities

  • Focus on building out custom wordpress plugins for internal agency needs
  • Focus on connecting marketing data for purposes of analysis, can range from open rates in crm, to costs on paid media platforms, to click through data on sms provider.
  • Setting up CRM lists, automations, and funnels from start to finish with script, reporting and directly on the platforms.
  • Willing to have a flexible set of responsibilities to service whatever is required in daily operations, including posting daily new article first thing in the mornings.
  • Work hand-in-hand with CTO and CMO on various directives. If you see a way to do it better, we'd love to hear it.
  • Handle multiple projects from start to finish, adhering to set deadlines set by CTO or CMO.
  • Doing or setting up manual/automated reporting related to adspend, subscriber counts, open rates, cost per lead, etc
  • Copying, testing, and fixing Elementor landing pages and ensuring they are properly connected to CRM, SMS, webhooks, etc.
  • Copying, testing, fixing PHP scripts ensuring they are properly connected to CRM, SMS provider, webhooks, postbacks, etc.
  • On CRM set up lists/segments, automations for the welcome emails, templates, list cleaning,
  • Doing specific weekly and monthly audits of our 10 newsletter landing page and script funnels.
  • Testing and helping manage our mobile app.
  • Test Planning and Execution:  Design and implement test plans, scenarios, and procedures to test software functionality. 
  • Defect Management:  Identify, document, and track software defects (that you can't fix), then work with developers to ensure they are corrected before release
  • Collaboration:  Communicate and collaborate with developers, product managers, and other team members to understand requirements and provide feedback on usability and functionality. 
  • Automation:  Code and implement automated test scripts using various tools and frameworks. 
  • Quality Standards:  Create and enforce guidelines for software quality standards within the company. 


Qualifications

  • Proficient in Wordpress, Elementor, PHP, HTML/CSS
  • Strong communication, conceptual thinking, problem solving skills
  • Deadline and detail-oriented
  • Self Starter who can be self-taught and work without much direction
  • Works well in collaboration with a team and independently.
  • Must have the ability to multitask, in a VERY fast paced work environment.
  • This position requires a personality that can accept constructive criticism, change directions rapidly and accept new assignments frequently with pressing deadlines.


Compensation

Salary: based on your experience level


To Apply Submit:

  • Current resume
  • Synopsis of recent salary history
  • If selected, you'll receive invite to a couple skills test before video interview


Requirements Before Employment

  • Signed Confidentiality agreement
  • Signed Non-compete agreement
  • Signed Contract & W-8 BEN tax form


Company Culture

  • Remote
  • We're playful, tight nit, friendly, family-oriented atmosphere.
  • We're very loyal, focused, dedicated and hard-working.
  • Hours 8AM - 5PM, Mon-Fri, with certain US holidays included

title: Product Owner
description:
About InComm

InComm is a global leader in the payments industry with over 30 years of experience and a presence in 30+ countries. As pioneers in gift cards, we hold two-thirds of the global market share.

Our mission is to revolutionize global commerce through innovative payment technologies for retailers, brands, and consumers.


About This Opportunity

As a Product Owner, you will work closely with both our Business Intelligence and Reporting Teams. In this position you will be accountable to manage data and reporting requirements to fulfill stakeholder or customer requests. You will also lead the roadmap and requirements analysis primarily for our financial systems.


The ideal candidate will have experience with Scrum/ Agile processes, Accounting/Financial Systems, SSRS, PowerBI, and Tableau. Knowledge of ETL and Oracle/Oracle EBS is a plus.


Professional English Language skills are required.


Position is CLT and fully remote (must reside in Brazil). Benefits include health and dental insurance, meal and restaurant vouchers, fixed monthly stipend for Internet and mobile expenses, InComm hardware/software, and annual bonuses!



Responsibilities

  • Work directly with Finance & Accounting leadership and BI teams on product backlog and coordinate with various technology teams across InComm to implement new solutions.
  • Build, manage and prioritize product backlog based on the overall strategy and business objectives for future product development.
  • Responsible for creating and/or managing following artifacts:

-Road Map

-Development Backlog

-User Stories and Sprint Tasks

-Supporting documents for user stories


  • Monitor and Review ServiceNow (SNOW) requests
  • Create product vision and roadmap which accomplishes the goal of the vision and convey that vision to the scrum team.
  • Ensure user stories are well defined and ready for development to begin.
  • Responsible for optimizing the value of the work done.
  • Accountable for each stage of the development process and the final product.
  • Ensure close collaboration with development team. Be available to address any questions team members have regarding requirements or implementation of a product feature.
  • Responsible for communicating with stakeholders across the board, including product managers, leadership, customers, and the development team to make sure their vision is aligned with business objectives.


Preferred Qualifications/Experience:

  • Experience with reporting and operations within Billing, Accounting, and Sales
  • Experience working in Agile/Technical environments
  • Skilled in and comfortable working alongside technical stakeholders, translating business needs into clear, actionable inputs for development or support teams.
  • Proficient in Agile/Scrum
  • Agile/Scrum Certification
  • General knowledge of ERP, Databases (Oracle & MS SQL) and DataLakesis a plus
  • SRS, PowerBI, and Tableau and knowledge of ETL.


InComm provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or national origin, citizenship, veteran’s status, age, disability status, genetics or any other category protected by federal, state, or local law.

title: Product Owner
description:
About InComm

InComm is a global leader in the payments industry with over 30 years of experience and a presence in 30+ countries. As pioneers in gift cards, we hold two-thirds of the global market share.

Our mission is to revolutionize global commerce through innovative payment technologies for retailers, brands, and consumers.


About This Opportunity

As a Product Owner, you will work closely with both our Business Intelligence and Reporting Teams. In this position you will be accountable to manage data and reporting requirements to fulfill stakeholder or customer requests. You will also lead the roadmap and requirements analysis primarily for our financial systems.


The ideal candidate will have experience with Scrum/ Agile processes, Accounting/Financial Systems, SSRS, PowerBI, and Tableau. Knowledge of ETL and Oracle/Oracle EBS is a plus.


Professional English Language skills are required.


Position is CLT and fully remote (must reside in Brazil). Benefits include health and dental insurance, meal and restaurant vouchers, fixed monthly stipend for Internet and mobile expenses, InComm hardware/software, and annual bonuses!



Responsibilities

  • Work directly with Finance & Accounting leadership and BI teams on product backlog and coordinate with various technology teams across InComm to implement new solutions.
  • Build, manage and prioritize product backlog based on the overall strategy and business objectives for future product development.
  • Responsible for creating and/or managing following artifacts:

-Road Map

-Development Backlog

-User Stories and Sprint Tasks

-Supporting documents for user stories


  • Monitor and Review ServiceNow (SNOW) requests
  • Create product vision and roadmap which accomplishes the goal of the vision and convey that vision to the scrum team.
  • Ensure user stories are well defined and ready for development to begin.
  • Responsible for optimizing the value of the work done.
  • Accountable for each stage of the development process and the final product.
  • Ensure close collaboration with development team. Be available to address any questions team members have regarding requirements or implementation of a product feature.
  • Responsible for communicating with stakeholders across the board, including product managers, leadership, customers, and the development team to make sure their vision is aligned with business objectives.


Preferred Qualifications/Experience:

  • Experience with reporting and operations within Billing, Accounting, and Sales
  • Experience working in Agile/Technical environments
  • Skilled in and comfortable working alongside technical stakeholders, translating business needs into clear, actionable inputs for development or support teams.

title: Analista tributário
description:
A Oliveira & Carvalho busca Analista Tributário e Previdenciário para compor seu time.

Somos uma consultoria tributária com uma cultura dinâmica, exigente e orientada a resultados. Investimos de forma consistente no desenvolvimento das pessoas e oferecemos espaço real para profissionais responsáveis, comprometidos e com vontade de fazer acontecer crescerem junto com a empresa.

Nosso ambiente é colaborativo, porém de alta responsabilidade. A atuação em home office exige disciplina, resiliência, maturidade profissional e dedicação. Aqui, a confiança está diretamente ligada à qualidade das entregas, ao cumprimento de prazos e ao comprometimento com resultados.


Requisitos:

Ensino superior completo em Ciências Contábeis, Administração de Empresas ou Direito.

Experiência com revisão e execução de procedimentos fiscais relacionadas à escrituração fiscal e apurações de ICMS, ICMS-ST, ISS, IRPJ, CSLL e PIS/COFINS cumulativos e não cumulativos e análise e conferência de documentação do cliente conforme o checklist para execução do projeto.

Domínio das obrigações acessórias para operacionalização e aproveitamento de créditos, tais como SPED FISCAL, EFD- Contribuições, ECD, ECF, DCTF e PER/DCOMP.

Atuação com impostos diretos e indiretos.

Conhecimento em empresas de Lucro presumido, real e simples nacional.

Necessário disponibilidade para atuação em demandas previdenciárias, se necessário.


Competências Necessárias:

Buscamos profissionais que demonstrem organização, atenção aos detalhes e senso de responsabilidade, com resiliência para lidar com prazos e demandas simultâneas. É fundamental possuir maturidade profissional para atuação remota, com disciplina, proatividade e foco em resultados. Valorizamos o comprometimento com a qualidade técnica e interesse genuíno em desenvolvimento contínuo.


Contrato: CLT

Remuneração: A combinar

Benefícios:

VR/VA no valor de R$30,00 por dia

Previdência Privada Opcional

Seguro de vida em Grupo

Plano de saúde 50%

Plano odontológico 50%

Regime: Home Office.

Local: Brasil

title: Cientista de Dados - SR
description:
Código da vaga: 57309


Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei Cientista de Dados - SR, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


Habilidades Principais:

  • Requisito: Inglês avançado
  • Sólida experiência em Ciência de Dados e Inteligência Artificial , incluindo exploração e análise de dados, modelagem estatística, análise preditiva, Machine Learning e IA aplicada .
  • Forte base em estatística aplicada a problemas do mundo real, com domínio de Python e SQL , além de feature engineering , validação, interpretação e explicabilidade de modelos.
  • Experiência com Cloud , preferencialmente Azure , e familiaridade com engenharia de dados , bancos, arquitetura e visualização de dados .
  • Vivência na concepção, desenvolvimento e implementação de soluções de Inteligência Artificial e modelos generativos , aplicados a casos reais de negócio (automação de conteúdo, assistentes inteligentes, NLP ).
  • Atuação como referência técnica em IA , traduzindo demandas de negócio em soluções analíticas e inteligentes, escaláveis e sustentáveis.
  • Desejável conhecimento em modelos de produção fabril .


- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Atuação híbrida; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.

  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.

Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.

Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!

Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Meitu Campus Ambassador (Design Track)
description:
Remote Work, Part-time, Internship


We’re looking for someone with a sharp eye for aesthetics who can catch the hottest visual styles on campus and help our products look and feel right for local users.


What You’ll Do:

● Capture Visual Trends: Continuously analyze the aesthetic preferences and popular styles among local students to guide product design.

● Localize Visuals: Help adjust marketing materials visually (like layout and cultural fit) and create visuals that align with local aesthetics.

● Be a design critic: Review our products (and competitors') from a user’s perspective identify visual or experience flaws, and give practical feedback.


We Hope You Are:

● Have a keen eye: naturally notice design, imagery, and visual trends in everyday life and social media; are interested in youth culture and what’s trending locally.

● Think like a visual detective: not just see if something looks good—but ask why it’s designed in that way and how it could be better.

● Care about user experience: pay attention to how visuals affect usability and enjoy comparing product designs critically.


Bonus Points If You Have:

● Extensive knowledge of local visual product usage habits gained from living in regions like North America, Latam America, or East/Southeast Asia.

● A background in design, art, visual communication, or digital media arts.

● Have hands-on experience in graphic design, UI/UX, video editing, or photography.

● Are part of design clubs, competitions, or create visual content yourself.


What You’ll Get:

Co-creation & Growth

● Early access to product features and training sessions

● Workshops on social media, product, or design


Rewards & Credit System

We’ll regularly post tasks with different credit values. Pick what interests you, complete tasks to earn credits and base pay. With an exceptional peformance, you will earn bonus creditws!

Redeem credits for:

● Annual Meitu VIP membership

● “Meitu Elite Campus Ambassador” Certificate + internship reference

● Meitu Special Deisgn

● Exclusive chats with Meitu experts/executive leadership

● Summer Internship Offer

● Greenlight for graduate hires interview (skip some interview rounds and get priority hiring after graduation)


About Meitu

Founded in 2008, Meitu is an AI-driven technology company that regards \"beauty\" as its core ideal. Guided by our mission to \"Uniting Art and Technology\", Meitu is committed to creating world-class imaging products that simplify the creation of images, videos, designs, and other visual content.


Meitu was listed in 2016 on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange(stock code 1357.HK). As of June 30, 2025, Meitu had 280 million global monthly active users, including 98 million from regions and countries outside Mainland China.


We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, disability, or veteran status.


At Meitu, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Senior Java Software Engineer
description:
Project Description:

Building a risk applications and tools for innovative international top-tier hedge fund from the ground up, comprising the systems for traders, pre-trade checks and analysis, risks and limits management, reports of trading activities, FIX connectivity, market data providers connectivity (e.g. Bloomberg B-pipe), etc.


Responsibilities:

We are seeking a highly skilled Java Developer with experience in developing and maintaining trading applications. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Java, Spring Boot, SQL, Redis, and Kafka. Candidates who have experience with Order Management Systems (OMS), exchange connectivity, FIX protocol, execution algorithms will be preferred.

You will work closely with portfolio managers, traders, quants, and other technologists to build robust, scalable, and low-latency systems that support our investment and trading activities.


  • Key Responsibilities:

Design, develop, and maintain core components of our Order Management and Execution Management Systems (OMS/EMS).

• Build and enhance exchange and broker connectivity including support for FIX protocol messaging and APIs.

• Work on trade lifecycle management, including order creation, routing, execution, and post-trade processes.

• Collaborate with traders and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions.

• Optimize system performance for low latency, high throughput, and fault tolerance.

• Provide level 3 support for production trading systems when necessary.


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • 8+ years of professional Java development experience, ideally in financial services.
  • Strong experience in Java, Spring boot, Kafka, Redis, SQL or similar technologies.
  • Strong understanding of multi-threading, concurrency, and performance tuning in Java.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot real-time trading issues.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Available and ready to provide level 3 support for production trading systems when necessary.


Languages:

English: C2 Proficient

title: Japanese Business Developer
description:
Mayflower is a technology company that alters the entertainment industry to a new level of perception and engagement.

We are developing a partner advertising high-load system with a large RPS, convenient and modern interface. We are growing exponentially and successfully implementing new technologies to accelerate this growth and the system as a whole.

Now we look for a Japanese Business Developer to join our Growth Traffic team


Job Responsibilities

Research and Analysis:

  • Conduct thorough market research on Asian markets to identify opportunities for business expansion.
  • Perform competitive research to stay updated on market trends, competitor activities, and potential market gaps.

Lead Generation:

  • Identify and qualify potential affiliates and business partners within target markets across Asia.
  • Maintain an organized pipeline of prospective affiliates, tracking outreach progress and follow-ups.

Outreach and Communication:

  • Proactively initiate contact and establish relationships with potential affiliates and business partners.
  • Manage initial outreach, clearly communicating our company’s value proposition to prospective partners.

Reporting and Collaboration:

  • Regularly report on progress, including research insights, outreach results, and onboarding statuses.
  • Collaborate closely with senior account managers and cross-functional teams to align affiliate strategies and achieve team goals.


Requirements

  • Fluency in Japanese language is a must
  • Fluency in English
  • At least one year of experience in lead generation or business development.
  • Strong Network: Ability to leverage an existing network of contacts to expedite outreach and sales
  • Communication Skills: Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
  • Self-Starter: Capable of working autonomously in a remote environment, with the motivation to consistently drive results.


Qualification that can be a plus:

  • Proven track of overachieving KPIs in Business Development or Sales positions.


Conditions

We know that great talent deserves great conditions, so here's what you can expect when joining us:

  • Full remote work.
  • Competitive compensation with a service contract.
  • Transparent performance reviews twice a year, with bonus opportunities and salary adjustments.
  • An annual allowance that you can use for home office improvements, sports activities, equipment upgrades, and more—tailor it to what benefits you most.
  • Investment in your development: paid language courses, access to various learning platforms, and a mindfulness benefit, including psychological support with 50% coverage.
  • Career growth in a fast-scaling project with opportunities to influence technical decisions.
  • A culture of recognition: our peer reward program celebrates contributions from across the team.

title: Engenheiro de software sênior
description:
Required Skills & Qualifications:


  • Experience: 5+ years in a Software Engineering role.
  • Language: Fluent in English with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Software Development Proficiency: Strong background in software engineering with proficiency in GoLang or Python. You should be comfortable with object-oriented programming, data structures, REST API design, and writing testable, production-quality code (not just operational scripts).
  • DevSecOps Expertise: Proven experience implementing security best practices in a CI/CD environment. Familiarity with automated security scanning, secrets management (e.g., HashiCorp Vault ), and compliance automation.
  • Containerization & Orchestration: Expert-level knowledge of Kubernetes , Docker , and Helm . Experience with Service Meshes like Istio or Linkerd is a plus.
  • Cloud Platforms: Proficiency with either GCP or AWS services.
  • CI/CD & GitOps: Deep experience with CI/CD platforms like GitLab/GitHub Actions and Jenkins .
  • Infrastructure as Code: Hands-on experience with Terraform .
  • Observability & Monitoring: Proven experience with the Prometheus/Grafana/Loki stack for monitoring, logging, and alerting.
  • Full Stack: A solid understanding of full-stack development principles to effectively support development teams.


Bonus Qualifications:


  • Experience with GitOps tools such as Argo CD or Flux .
  • Relevant certifications, such as AWS/GCP Certified.
  • Familiarity with other observability tools like Jaeger or OpenTelemetry.

title: Senior Software Engineer UX (C# / XAML)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Software Engineer, UX, with 5+ years of professional experience to join our U.S. client. Candidates must have a strong background in C#, XAML, WinForms, and MAUI.

The ideal candidate will collaborate with a small team in an agile environment to improve our clients' UI experiences by developing new functionality and maintaining existing client applications. You must have experience with UI design, development, and debugging.

Protecting over 17,000 facilities in 80 countries across six continents, our client is a global leader in providing comprehensive visibility into critical infrastructure management, enabling swift problem resolution, waste reduction, and cost efficiencies while significantly elevating operational performance. The company's suite of software solutions enables customers to quickly identify and remediate critical plant issues, elevate plant operational performance, and ultimately drive safer, more efficient, always-on operations.


Responsibilities

  • Seek input from stakeholders, share and review UI mockups, synthesize feedback on usability, carefully consider localization, and empower other team members to create learning materials for the new UI
  • Develop view models, views, custom controls, and UI patterns in C# and XAML in both MAUI and WPF
  • Transform existing WinForms dialogs into reimagined and improved WPF implementations
  • Take ownership of solving interesting problems, architect new objects, improve the solutions of other team members, and maintain the solution as it is deployed globally


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments using C# and XAML
  • Strong proficiency in WinForms and MAUI
  • Ability to contribute across the stack from back-end logic and data modeling to key front-end integrations
  • Strong understanding of component-based architecture, state management, responsive design, and performance optimization
  • Experience working collaboratively with design and back-end teams
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams


Preferred Experience

  • Experience with third-party controls, such as Telerik and ComponentOne
  • Experience with web development, such as Angular and ASP.NET
  • Familiar with Microsoft SQL Server and Entity Framework


Additional Information:

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - Think Big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!

title: Técnico de Suporte II
description:
Missão do Cargo

Responsável pela manutenção e monitoramento dos ativos de redes, bem como seus serviços, visando a disponibilidade dos recursos (hardware e software) necessários para todo o Grupo Pereira.


Se interessou e faz sentido para você e para a sua carreira? Veja as principais atividades:

• Monitorar a disponibilidade do Data Center garantindo o pleno funcionamento de todos os sistemas de redundância, por meio de rondas diárias e monitoramento on-line;

• Monitorar a performance e disponibilidade de links de comunicação das unidades, e tomar as providências necessárias caso haja falhas ou erros, através da abertura de chamado nas operadoras e/ou substituição/manutenção de ativos danificados, garantindo o restabelecimento da comunicação;

• Auxiliar os usuários no uso correto das ferramentas disponibilizadas pela empresa, por meio de orientação e/ou elaboração de manual técnico;

• Salvaguardar que os procedimentos de monitoramento e segurança de redes sejam cumpridos, por meio das Políticas de redes existente.


O que esperamos do(a) nosso(a) Técnico de Suporte:

• Ensino Superior Completo em Redes de Computadores ou áreas correlatas;

• Conhecimento básico nas ferramentas de monitoramento ZABBIX ou Nagios;

• TCP/IP IPv4 (Noções Básicas);

• Hardware de Servidor (Básico);

• Sistemas Operacionais proprietários e livres (noções básicas);

• Redes wireless (básico);

• Cabeamento Estruturado;

• Configuração de Equipamentos de Interconexão.


O nosso propósito é ser um bom lugar para passar a vida, pensando nisso oferecemos:

• Plano de Saúde;

• Plano Odontológico;

• Seguro de Vida;

• Refeição no Local;

• Vale transporte;

• Suporte Social;

• Descontos especiais para compras em nossas redes.

title: Consultor SAP SRM/MM
description:
A Atos é líder global em transformação digital, com 112 mil colaboradores em 73 países e receita anual de €12 bilhões. Há mais de 30 anos no Brasil conectando pessoas, negócios e tecnologia para ajudar a melhorar o mundo em que vivemos.


Sobre a Vaga

Buscamos uma Pessoa Consultora SAP SRM/MM para atuar em projetos e sustentação, com foco em processos de compras, melhorias contínuas e atendimento de chamados. A atuação será em ambiente remoto, com desafios técnicos e funcionais em um contexto corporativo.


Modelo de Trabalho: Home Office

Contratação: CLT

Prazo: Indeterminado

Horário: Comercial


Responsabilidades:

  • Atuar no suporte e atendimento de chamados relacionados aos módulos SAP SRM e SAP MM .
  • Realizar configurações (customizing) de acordo com os processos de negócio.
  • Trabalhar com gestão de contratos, cotações e pedidos de compra .
  • Desenvolver e implementar melhorias funcionais e técnicas .
  • Realizar dimensionamento de esforço para demandas e projetos.
  • Atuar com WEBDYNPRO , WORKFLOW de aprovação e ABAP para DEBUG quando necessário.
  • Apoiar áreas de negócio na otimização de processos e soluções SAP.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada com SAP SRM .
  • Experiência comprovada com SAP MM .
  • Conhecimento de processos de compras: gestão de contratos, cotações e pedidos de compra .
  • Experiência com configurações nos módulos.
  • Atuação com atendimento de chamados e implementação de melhorias .
  • Conhecimento funcional em WEBDYNPRO .
  • Conhecimento em WORKFLOW de aprovação .
  • Conhecimento em ABAP para DEBUG .
  • Graduação completa .


Diferencial:

  • Conhecimento em RM .


O que oferecemos:


✓ Vale refeição ou Vale alimentação

✓ Plano de saúde extensível a cônjuge e filhos

✓ Plano odontológico

✓ Programa de remuneração variável

✓ Auxílio creche - conforme regras sindicais da localidade

✓ Wellhub (Gympass)

✓ Convênio com farmácias – descontos em medicamentos

✓ Previdência Privada com seguro de vida adicional

✓ Seguro de vida

✓ Empréstimo Consignado (após 1 ano de empresa)

✓ Convênio com empresas parceiras (Descontos para realização de graduação, pós-graduação, MBA e Idiomas)

✓ Política de Subsídios para Pós-graduação, MBAs e Certificações (A Atos apoia o seu desenvolvimento, subsidiando financeiramente ações externas)

✓ Speexx (curso online de até 5 idiomas gratuitamente)

✓ Programa de treinamentos internos e externos

✓ Universidade corporativa (E-learning com milhares de cursos disponíveis gratuitamente)

✓ Terapia online

✓ Programa de acompanhamento à gestante (acompanhamento médico online durante a gestação para colaboradoras ou cônjuges)

✓ Programa Minha Nova Parceria de Confiança (para colaboradores e cônjuges. Válido também para filhos adotivos) - Brinde especial + Cartão presente com valor em dinheiro

✓ Day off no seu aniversário

✓ Parceria com a Samsung (descontos na compra de diversos produtos)

✓ Bônus de indicação para nossas vagas (conforme política interna)

✓ Jubileu (premiação personalizada por tempo de empresa)

✓ Accolade (Programa de reconhecimento)


Entendemos a diversidade como um fator valioso. Por isso, independentemente da sua identidade ou expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, etnia, idade, deficiência, cidadania ou qualquer outro aspecto que o torne único, inscreva-se!

title: Back End - .NET Sênior
description:
Código da vaga: 57466


Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei desenvolvedor(a), venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


  • Experiência comprovada com desenvolvimento em .NET, aplicando boas práticas de codificação.
  • Experiência com DevOps.
  • Vivência prática com serviços AWS (S3, EC2, EKS, Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, entre outros).
  • Conhecimento técnico em Node.js e Python.
  • Experiência em conteinerização de aplicações.
  • Conhecimento em React, Next.js e TypeScript.
  • Diferencial: familiaridade com Minimal API e certificação AWS.



- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: ServiceNow Developer with Strategic Portfolio Management(SPM) & ITSM
description:
Title: ServiceNow Developer with Strategic Portfolio Management(SPM) & ITSM

Location: 100% Remote

Job Type: Contract

Job Specific Responsibilities:

● Have the ability to assist requesters in refining business requirement details to ensure the customers will be receiving functionality requested.

● Gain knowledge of our overall ServiceNow implementation to understand and identify cross platform impacts of changes or enhancements being requested.

● Design, develop, and implement SPM solutions including workflows, catalog items, workspaces, and integrations to meet complex business requirements

● Configure and customize the ServiceNow platform using javascript and ServiceNow APIs to extend capabilities and enhance user experience

● Design and implement workflows to support business needs and increase automation

● Develop and configure integrations between ServiceNow and other enterprise systems using integration spokes or custom APIs

● Work within the Agile methodology to develop, build and test alongside other developers to ensure the best product is delivered to requestors in a timely manner

● Work with implementation partners, or internal project teams to Implement new modules as business needs evolve

● Assist with regular ServiceNow version upgrades to ensure we remain compliant and supported by the vendor

Key Skills, Requirements and Competencies:

● Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or a relevant technical field

● At least 3+ years experience working with the ServiceNow platform, specifically in the SPM module, and with good familiarity with ITSM, and the general ServiceNow platform

● Strong understanding of ITIL principles and practices

● Proficiency in JavaScript and ServiceNow API web services

● Proven experience with integrating ServiceNow with other applications

● Excellent analytical and problem solving skills

● Effective communication and interpersonal skills

Thanks

Aatmesh

description:
Sobre a Empresa


Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Data Analyst - Sr

Required experience

Required experience Recommended experience: 5-7 years of hands-on BI application development experience

Ability to identify technical, security risks and propose mitigation actions

Hands on experience of Configuration & Release Management

Practices Participate in software modification during integration testing

Understand requirements from the stakeholders and documenting such requirements.

Transpose business requirements into data solutions.

Propose changes to improve efficiency and/or reduce operation or maintenance cost;

Create good practices and propose improvements

Gather functional and non functional, including information security requirements from the stakeholders and document such requirements.


Mandatory Skills

Advanced Data Analysis and Data Modeling skills.

Strong expertise SQL and it’s application on distributed data processing frameworks (e.g., Spark). Practical knowledge of Python development for data pipelines.

Strong expertise on developing Data Visualization apps in Power BI, including advanced DAX for complex measures’ creation, semantic models, data flows, datasets and deployment pipelines. Solid background in Git-based version control. Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines.

Experience with Azure DevOps.

Understanding of Databricks Unity Catalog, clusters, and SQL Warehouses. Comfort using CLI tools and scripting (e.g., Azure CLI, Databricks CLI).

Familiarity with app registrations and service principals.


Recommended Skills

Excellent Communication:

Ability to interact effectively with international teams, business, and IT Knowledge of the industrial, automotive, or logistics sectors.

Experience working with European teams. Experience with Azure Data Factory.

Experience with Databricks.

Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure Functions and Azure Web Apps.

Background in API integrations and JSON-based messaging.


Degree

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.


Idioma:

Imprescindível inglês fluente para atuar com equipes internacionais


CLT - obrigatório

Benefícios:

Vale Refeição - Cartão Swille

title: Senior Software (TypeScript/Ruby/React) Engineer
description:
Summary

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help shape and scale a modern web experience for a fast-paced, consumer-facing product team. You’ll work closely with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver elegant, performant, and maintainable applications using TypeScript, Ruby on Rails and React . This role is ideal for someone who possesses a high level of agency, a \"doer\" mentality, and the ability to maintain a full product vision while shipping high-quality code at speed.


Core Requirements :

  • Mastery of TypeScript and React for building complex, scalable web applications.
  • 5+ years of professional experience in frontend development with a proven track record of shipping production-grade software.
  • Experience working with Ruby on Rails (or interest in a product where RoR is core)
  • Prior experience in the Trading, Brokerage, or Wealth Management industries.
  • Demonstrated high level of agency and a proactive \"doer\" mentality, with the ability to hit the ground running and own features end-to-end.
  • Strong product sense and the ability to build for the long term while balancing immediate delivery needs.
  • Excellent understanding of modern frontend architecture, state management, and performance optimization.
  • Solid experience with unit testing and a commitment to maintaining high code quality through thoughtful testing practices.
  • Comfort navigating fast-paced environments and collaborating within cross-functional agile teams.
  • Strong eye for design-to-dev fidelity and a passion for creating fluid, responsive user interfaces.


Nice to Have :

  • Full-stack development experience or a strong understanding of backend systems and API design.
  • Experience working with GraphQL APIs and modern data-fetching libraries.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows for web applications.
  • Exposure to modern CSS-in-JS libraries or advanced styling frameworks.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Our client is a U.S.-based company that provides technical expertise, testing, and certification services to the global food and agricultural industry. Their mission is to ensure food safety, quality, and sustainability across international supply chains.


They are seeking a highly skilled Senior Software Engineer to design, develop, and optimize the core APIs and data services powering their flagship SaaS platform. This role focuses requires expertise in TypeScript/JavaScript, C#/.NET and Azure cloud development practices. You will also help set technical direction, mentor other engineers, and ensure the software meets the highest standards for performance, scalability, and security.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Design and develop RESTful APIs and backend services using .NET/C# on Azure Web Apps
  • Model and manage SQL data structures (Azure SQL) to support complex engineering workflows.
  • Build responsive, accessible UI screens in HTML and TypeScript, leveraging the Webix control platform to deliver clean, maintainable front-end components
  • Implement security best practices including IAM role configuration, least-privilege access, and API authentication/authorization.
  • Write and maintain test automation to ensure code quality and reduce regression risk.
  • Participate in DevOps practices including CI/CD pipeline maintenance, infrastructure-as-code (YAML), and application monitoring using telemetry tools Application Insights and KUSTO language.
  • Leverage AI-powered assistants and developer tools to reduce repetitive work, improve code quality, and accelerate delivery.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with international teams including Product Managers, UX designers, test engineers, and DevOps.
  • Mentor team members on best practices in software architecture, design patterns, and coding standards.
  • Conduct code reviews to ensure adherence to established guidelines.


This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employees may be asked to perform additional tasks as required, that may or may not be related to their primary duties.


Required Qualifications:


  • BA/BS degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience
  • 5+ years of professional experience developing SaaS applications.
  • 2+ years in .NET/C# for developing RESTful APIs.
  • 2+ years Web API, JSON, and TypeScript consuming RESTful APIs
  • Proficiency in version control tools (e.g., Git) and Agile development practices.
  • Experience with SQL databases such as SQL Server / Oracle
  • Ability to work independently in short delivery cycles with minimal rework.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture and design patterns.


This is a CRT Role at R$18,000/month + Annual Bonus

title: Brazil - Remote: Tech Lead
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.


Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:

  • Backend: Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi-agent AI systems.
  • Data: Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture.
  • Frontend: Building the \"Control Room\" and complex AI interfaces.
  • DevOps: Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments.

Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together. ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend’s \"Visualizations\" and that the \"Data Pipelines\" are reliably deployed by DevOps.


What You’ll Do

  • Technical Orchestration: You will drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. You will decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph .
  • Code & Quality Standards: Enforce high standards across the stack. You will review API designs (FastAPI), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates.
  • The \"Expert\": When the DevOps engineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On-Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution.
  • Team Leadership: Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translating high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.


Qualifications

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams.
  • Deep proficiency in Python Backend Development .
  • Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading).
  • Experience designing or managing Data Intensive Applications (understanding ETL, Streams, or Data Lakes).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
  • Advanced English communication skills.


Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Experience with Digital Twins , IoT, or Industrial Data.
  • Experience with GenAI/LLM architecture (RAG, Agents).
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

The Technology Stack

You do not need to be an expert in every single tool, but you must be able to discuss technical trade-offs across the entire stack:

  • Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI), Kafka, Neo4j, LangGraph.
  • Frontend: Angular 16+, TypeScript, RxJS, Plotly.js.
  • Data: Apache Airflow, Delta Lake, Polars/Spark.
  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/K3s), Terraform, Hybrid Cloud


Desired Profile

  • The Architect-Implementer: You can draw the system architecture on a whiteboard, but you are not afraid to open an IDE to debug a failing pipeline or a slow query.
  • The Polyglot: You are likely a Backend or Full-Stack native, but you understand the complexity of Frontend state management (NgRx/Signals) and the constraints of Medallion Data Architectures.
  • Reliability Mindset: You understand that we are dealing with critical industrial environments. You prioritize testing, validation, and security.


Halliburton is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.


Location

Fully Remote position.


Job Details

Requisition Number:

Experience Level: Mid to Senior

Job Family: Engineering/Science/Technology

Product Service Line: Landmark Software & Services

Full Time / Part Time: Full Time

Employee Group: Temporary
